aarti.tek: Victory, victory, victory to you, divine Gaṇeśa, whose mother is Pārvatī and father Mahādeva.
aarti.pad1: One-tusked and compassionate, you have four arms; a tilaka graces your forehead, and you ride a mouse. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Betel leaves are offered to you, flowers are offered, and dried fruits; laddus are set before you, and saints serve you. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You give sight to the blind, a sound body to lepers, sons to childless women and wealth to the poor. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Keep the honour of the humble, O son of Śiva, I give myself to you; fulfil every wish, for the whole world gives itself to you. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Sūraśyāma has come to your refuge: make his service fruitful. Your mother is Pārvatī and your father Mahādeva. ॥5॥
